_comment: Single source of truth for the per-platform matrix. references/platforms.md is generated from this file: node scripts/integrations-store.mjs render-platforms --write. A status is 'verified' only for something actually exercised, with the date and what was seen in 'evidence'.

platforms.name: Employer career pages on Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby

search.method: Employer's own public JSON feed per company (boards-api.greenhouse.io, api.lever.co, api.ashbyhq.com); no key. The company list is the user's (companies.txt)

apply.method: On the employer's page, by the user or a permitted browser session. Greenhouse's application API needs the employer's own API key (per third-party documentation, not checked), so it is not available to candidates

platforms.limits: Read-only; one request per second per host; no endpoint lists all customers
platforms.evidence: Six boards (Stripe, Databricks, GitLab, Palantir, Ramp, Notion) returned HTTP 200 JSON; 84 intern postings parsed

platforms.name: freehire.me public API

search.method: GET /api/v1/jobs/search with facets (employment_type, work_mode, countries, collections, company_type); no key

apply.method: Records link to the original posting; apply there

platforms.auth: None for the public read endpoints
platforms.limits: Personal, non-commercial use; 600 requests per minute per address; records are an aggregator copy, open the original before treating as verified
platforms.evidence: HTTP 200; 2,434 India internships, 452 YC-company internships, 62 global remote internships that day

platforms.name: Internshala

search.method: Public listing pages (/internship/detail/) read one at a time; robots.txt allows that path

apply.method: On the site, signed in as the user, by the user. Not automated

platforms.auth: User's own account for applying; none for reading public pages
platforms.limits: India-focused; a listing that says it is unavailable is closed
platforms.evidence: A public listing page loaded and reported itself unavailable; robots.txt read

platforms.name: Wellfound

search.method: Leads from web search; listing fetch is unreliable

apply.method: On the site, by the user

platforms.limits: Parameterised job URLs are disallowed by robots.txt; one fetched listing returned HTTP 410 (gone)

platforms.name: LinkedIn

search.method: Public web-search snippets as leads only; linkedin.com is never fetched or scraped. No official job-search API was found or checked

apply.method: The user, in their own signed-in browser

messaging.method: Copy-ready draft; the user sends it in LinkedIn. Gmail cannot send LinkedIn messages

platforms.auth: The user's own login in their own browser; the agent never receives credentials
platforms.limits: robots.txt prohibits automated access without permission; the agent never reads profiles or people search
platforms.evidence: robots.txt read; only search snippets seen

platforms.name: Indeed
platforms.limits: robots.txt disallows /viewjob for generic crawlers; any partner or publisher API was not checked

platforms.name: Naukri.com

search.method: None: robots.txt and a listing page both returned HTTP 403

platforms.limits: Inaccessible to automated reads; do not bypass. The user can paste a URL or the posting text
platforms.evidence: HTTP 403 on robots.txt and on a listing

platforms.name: Glassdoor

search.method: None tried. Its terms and robots.txt were not reviewed, so it is treated as unsupported until they are

platforms.limits: Manual leads only: the user pastes a link

platforms.name: Gmail

messaging.method: Gmail API: read with gmail.readonly (restricted scope), send with gmail.send (sensitive scope); each authorized separately. Replies thread with In-Reply-To and References headers

platforms.auth: OAuth 2.0 loopback flow with PKCE, using a Desktop-app OAuth client the user creates in their own Google Cloud project; tokens stay outside the repository
platforms.limits: No compose, modify or delete scope is requested, so mail is never altered. For a personal Google Cloud project the consent screen shows an unverified-app notice. How long refresh tokens last for an app in Testing status was not verified; re-authorize if access stops working
platforms.evidence: Not configured; documented in Google's Gmail API and OAuth 2.0 desktop-app guides (read 2026-10-27)

messaging.method: Not implemented. Microsoft Graph exists but was not checked
